prompts.thor_orbit_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, photorealistic grounded military science-fiction cinematic game background.
Create ONE opaque 16:9 image, high resolution ideally 3840 x 2160, to deliver at 1920 x 1080.
REFERENCE IMAGE: the attached transparent satellite image defines the original THOR spacecraft design. Preserve its recognizable long charcoal angular bus, TWO flat dark-blue rectangular solar wings, underside bundled long tungsten rod magazine, steel clamp racks and panel proportions. Do not show a cutout backdrop.
SCENE: Low Earth orbit over the night side of the eastern United States centered above the Kentucky region, post-apocalyptic Earth nearly dark with ONLY a few tiny isolated remnant city lights. No dense bright city networks, no labels or map boundaries. A thin cold blue atmosphere rim curves across the LOWER THIRD of the frame, the dark Earth surface and faint cloud swirls occupying the lower third. Deep nearly black space above, sparse barely visible stars.
COMPOSITION: The satellite is in the UPPER MIDDLE of the frame, around x=52%, y=35%, fully visible, horizontally spanning about 52-58% of image width, seen at three-quarter angle from slightly below. Leave the TOP-LEFT and TOP-RIGHT quarters calm, dark and uncluttered for game HUD text. Leave the BOTTOM-CENTRE dark and calm too, with no bright city lights, foreground objects or graphic overlays there. Keep all hardware away from outer corners.
One SINGLE long tungsten rod has just cleared the magazine below the spacecraft, descending diagonally toward Earth, thin and unmistakably straight with a very faint white-hot pinpoint at its Earth-facing tip. The rod is separate and fully visible below the bus, roughly x=60%, y=53%. Restrained tip glow only, no fiery plume, large explosion, smoke or laser beam.
LIGHT: cinematic photographic illumination from a sun just below the horizon; no visible sun disc or lens flare. Subtle edge illumination on graphite panels, neutral highlights on tungsten and cool cyan #3B7C8F / #60C8E6 accents. Grounded realistic worn military aerospace hardware, believable thermal blankets/trusses and solar cells, no shiny toy appearance. Maintain silhouette readability despite the dark night setting.
HARD EXCLUSIONS: no text, numerals, lettering, markings, logos, emblems, watermarks, targeting reticles, HUD graphics, borders, humanoid robots or other spacecraft. Original design, not from another franchise. Opaque full-frame background.
prompts.thor_earth_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached orbital scene. Create ONLY its clean Earth/space background plate for an animated game overlay, 16:9 2048x1152 or higher. Remove the entire satellite, both solar wings, its rod magazine and the detached falling rod. Fill those regions seamlessly with very dark sparse starfield. Preserve the existing planet's framing, curvature, blue atmospheric rim across lower third, clouds, few scattered surviving eastern United States city lights near Kentucky, photographic lighting, black space and calm dark corners. No spacecraft, no rods, no text, no numbers, no logos, no reticle, no watermark. Fully opaque image. Keep the planet and horizon as close to input as possible.
prompts.thor_actual_reference_cutout_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. EDIT ONLY the attached image: isolate the large main white-and-yellow satellite as a transparent cutout. This is NOT a redesign or a new satellite. Preserve its exact original appearance, geometry, silhouette, arrangement, camera orientation, colors, texture, and proportions: white rectangular central equipment box with yellow triangular/conical forward section; round exposed open cage at upper rear; two long light gray rectangular solar panel wings down either side attached to slim lateral booms; small white round dish and all thin support wires. Preserve the reference image appearance faithfully. Remove ONLY black space background, the separate small satellite fragment at top right, the detached rod at right, and the little bottom-left overlay icon. Do not add, replace or modernize any part. No charcoal recoloring, no cyan substitution, no armored hull, no extra rods or open hatch, no new text or labels. The left panel edge touches source border: preserve the visible portion without inventing its missing extension. Put existing cutout at center of a slightly larger transparent canvas with padding, entirely visible, unchanged perspective. Actual RGBA alpha, solid spacecraft opaque, clean antialiased edge, no residual black background or halo. Best-faith extraction from original; not an illustration inspired by it.
prompts.thor_actual_reference_cleanup_prompt: Precise cleanup edit of this transparent satellite cutout. Preserve EXACT spacecraft shape, white-and-yellow colors, camera angle, two light-gray long solar wings, every proportion and component. Change ONLY two things: remove the tiny colored logo/insignia on the left-facing white equipment-box panel leaving plain white metal there; clean stray white/cyan pixel debris immediately outside silhouette while preserving thin antenna wires. Keep actual transparent background and opaque solid spacecraft with edge antialiasing. Do not redraw or redesign any hardware, do not add rods, hatch or details. No text, numbers, logos, watermarks anywhere. Preserve full image framing.
prompts.thor_rod_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a single isolated tungsten orbital kinetic rod game sprite on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Extremely tall narrow composition: final crop will be 160x900 so use a tall portrait canvas and keep all nontransparent content inside its central narrow 17% width, with ample transparent space to either side. ONE long slender solid cylindrical tungsten dart exactly vertical, pointing STRAIGHT DOWN, perfectly centered axis x50%. The pointed bottom tip glows white hot with tiny cold cyan bloom; opaque dark brushed gunmetal shaft, faint cyan edge highlight, simple machined rear end at top, no fins or missile engine. A SHORT wispy fading white/cyan plasma wake extends directly upward from top end; transparent fade, no smoke cloud. Rod shaft spans from y25% to90%; glow tip at y90%; short trail y8% to25%. Keep all effects away from canvas edges. Photographic grounded military sci-fi asset. No background, floor, shadow, stars, text, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, detached objects. Neutral cold metallic surface, no orange. Real alpha transparency; solid rod interior opaque; trail and tip glow have soft alpha.
